A few hints to play easier and grow faster.

• Hire Spike the hedgehog as early as you can. He costs only 100 coins, and every tap becomes 1.5 times stronger.
  • The MAX button in Departments buys as much as your money allows. No need to press Buy twenty times.
  • Watch the strip at the top of the screen. It always shows the next goal, for example “Buy “Candles and matches”: 7/25”.

• To expand the shop you need three things: buy the required departments, upgrade the animals and collect coins. The conditions are in the Departments tab, in the Expansion block.
  • Every new shop level gives ×2 to all income, so expand at the first chance.

• Bonus games: the dance floor in the Disco era, Grandpa Ryo’s noodle cart in Japan and the witch’s hut at Halloween. That is where skins are won.
  • The fortune circus gives crystals and bonuses, so do not walk past the tent.
  • Achievement rewards. Look into the tab with the cup, prizes are waiting there.
  • Street events. The red “!”, an owl or a raccoon appear only for a moment. Tap in time and you get a bonus.
Time travel resets the shop but gives time shards, a new era and a permanent income bonus. Do not be afraid of it: the next round goes much faster.
